projects.title: Markov Chains and their relation to The Royal and Most Pleasant Game of Goose
projects.description:
▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂
Implemented two simulations for The Royal and Most Pleasant Game of Goose. One to play the game, with all rules implemented, and simulate n amount of times using threads. The other to apply the game to a Markov Chain, so we are able to see the probability of what space the player could be on at any given turn using matrix multiplication. We produced a write-up explaining the process and its significance in a LaTex document.

projects.title: Logic Gate Simulator
projects.description:
▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂▂
Created a logic gate simulator that takes inputs from a Gui (written with Qt libs) that communicates with a backend (written in C++) to calculate the final state of all gates and returns it to the Gui for a visual representation. This project was conducted in an Agile-based environment and decisions were made collectively. Our group conducted a multitude of presentations to the project owner and outsourced to other groups in the course for in-depth testing.
